headline: Heating, from 1 January crackdown on meters and heat cost allocators: what changes, costs and risks for those who do not comply
summary: From 1 January, Italy will crack down on meters and heat cost allocators in centralised heating systems. Condominium residents face costs and risks if they do not comply.
why: Heating cost allocation rules determine how building energy bills are split among residents, affecting household spending and building-maintenance costs in Italy.
